articles.summary: Software development engineers play crucial roles at Roku. They are the architects behind the innovative applications, complex algorithms, and efficient systems that power our systems and products. However, as we strive to optimize their development processes and utilization of resources, measuring productivity becomes an increasingly challenging task. In this blog post, we will delve deeper … Continue reading "Unlocking Potential: Rethinking How We Measure Developer Productivity" The post Unlocking Potential: Rethinking How We Measure Developer Productivity appeared first on Engineering Blog .
